policy: Keyword routing is a heuristic nomination, never a verdict. A NO_MATCH falls back to the vocabulary-free generic ontology, where term/theory/mechanism links are REFUSED instead of invented. Adding a domain = adding one JSON file plus one entry here; no engine code changes. Keywords are lower-cased substring matches and include surface forms in EN, TR, DE, ES/PT/IT/FR and RU; choose specific tokens, avoid short ones.
selection_policy: There is NO shipped default domain. The user confirms the expertise domain explicitly (`python domain.py use --ontology <domain>`) and the choice is recorded in domain.config.json. Until then the generic ontology applies and every term/theory/mechanism link is refused (T9). `attention.py` scores candidate domains from keywords, file NAMES (material_hints) and store continuity - deterministic weighted scoring, not a neural model, and never a verdict.
claim_limit: Routing decides which vocabulary to load, not what is true. A matched domain does not verify any claim.
